notes.title: Game Hotfix
notes.notes:
There are cases where things get stuck continuously, so I proceeded with updates to solve them.

- Fixed the maximum speed of the axe at 2.5 times the maximum throw speed.
- The object's logic priority has been adjusted.
- The duck's collision logic has been adjusted.

I'm continuously modifying the content based on the play content and feedback. [b]Retention of rotational speed is temporarily suspended.[/b] If there is something wrong with the play, please leave your comment.

I'll be back as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update Annoucement
notes.notes:
Gamers' passion is also heating up in proportion to the weather. Therefore, I would like to share the concept and screenshot of the new stage that I announced before the release.

[h2]Concept and Progress[/h2]

Currently, I'm making maps with the concept of [b]'Winter'[/b] and are developing them smoothly. I've got all the sprite related to winter, and now I'm working on optimizing the collider and putting it on the map. I think I can say that it's about 70% development progress.

[h2]Release Date[/h2]

The stage will be completed as soon as possible and will be available free of charge to anyone who has purchased Press Axe in time for this upcoming summer sale. Unless there is a major setback in the test, I will make it possible to play without clearing the previous stage.

I hope this update will cool off many people. Reveals some screenshots of maps in progress.
